intro.text: A Kholin swordmaster ardent in Urithiru who can beat Dalinar two duels out of three.

items.text: Kelerand helped train Dalinar's troops and run the barracks; Dalinar praised his training rooms and told him to expand them to keep the soldiers busy.
Like many ardents, Kelerand was uneasy about Dalinar's marriage to Navani and his claims about the Almighty. When Dalinar asked him to spar, he said he would if ordered but would rather not.
